topics.purpose: Define exact linkage from PortfolioCore entries to universal Project identities and associated work evidence without introducing a separate portfolio-project primitive.

semantics.project_rule: Link targets an existing universal Project identity.
semantics.role_rule: Identity's role in the Project is explicit relation metadata where relevant.
semantics.evidence_rule: Artifacts/outcomes/references are linked separately and retain original provenance.
semantics.recursive_rule: Portfolio may reference any relevant Project level, while executable work semantics remain in leaf Projects.
semantics.employment_rule: Long-running employment relationships represented as Projects may be referenced like any other Project.
semantics.ownership_rule: PortfolioCore owns the link/description, not Project semantics.

invariants.rule: PortfolioCore represents explicit identity-linked references and evidence metadata; it never manufactures competence, merit, trust or authorization from presentation content.

hard_gates.condition: role inferred from prose only where machine-significant
Project execution semantics moved into PortfolioCore
